wokewtf.lite.mod.name: woke.wtf Lite
wokewtf.lite.module.hud.fps.description: Shows the current client frame rate.
wokewtf.lite.module.hud.fps.setting.anch: Which corner or edge the counter is pinned to.
wokewtf.lite.module.ui.crosshair.descrip: Draws your own crosshair: shape, colour, thickness and arm length.
wokewtf.lite.module.ui.crosshair.setting: Cross for the classic four-arm crosshair, Dot for a single square, Hidden for none at all.
Empty units between the centre and each arm.
wokewtf.lite.module.ui.chat.description: Adds timestamps to chat and keeps a longer scrollback.
wokewtf.lite.module.ui.chat.setting.time: Prefix every chat line with the local time.
wokewtf.lite.module.ui.chat.setting.hist: How many chat lines the client keeps for scrolling back. Vanilla keeps 100.
wokewtf.lite.module.ui.book.description: Shows how full the page of an open book is.
wokewtf.lite.module.ui.book.setting.coun: Show the characters used on the page, or how many are left.
wokewtf.lite.module.ui.screenshot.descri: Puts a reference to a new screenshot on the clipboard: its path, or a file:// link.
wokewtf.lite.module.ui.screenshot.settin: Put the screenshot's file path on the clipboard as soon as it is saved.
Copy a file:// link to the screenshot instead of its plain path, so it can be pasted into another program. Off by default; the file never leaves this machine.
wokewtf.lite.module.ui.waypoints.descrip: Lists your own saved positions of the world you are in, nearest first.
wokewtf.lite.module.ui.waypoints.setting: Which corner or edge the list is pinned to.
wokewtf.lite.module.ui.inventory_sort.de: Reorders your inventory from /wokewtf sort. Singleplayer or LAN host only.
wokewtf.lite.module.ui.inventory_sort.se: By item name, or biggest stacks first.
Also reorder the hotbar, not just the inventory.
After the connection drops, counts down in chat and reconnects. Off by default and always cancellable.
Seconds to wait before reconnecting. The countdown is printed in chat.
Connection to %s lost. Reconnecting in %s seconds; the Cancel Reconnect keybind stops it.
The reconnect attempt did not finish. Not retrying.
Could not start a reconnect to %s.
wokewtf.lite.module.util.respawn_confirm: Holds the respawn button back for a moment so a stray click cannot send you back in. Never respawns you itself.
Seconds the respawn button stays inactive after the death screen opens.
wokewtf.lite.module.util.chat_macros.des: Keybinds that type a saved line into chat. Nothing is sent until you press Enter. Off by default.
wokewtf.lite.module.util.chat_macros.set: Edited with /wokewtf macro set <name> <text>. Up to 20 macros.
A key of your own for the game's screenshot. Off and unbound by default.
Toggles fullscreen from a key of your own. Off and unbound by default.
wokewtf.lite.module.util.stats.descripti: Counts blocks mined, distance walked and playtime on this client only. No upload and no ranking.
wokewtf.lite.keybind.conflict: %s keybind(s) share a key with another binding: %s. Rebind them in Controls.
wokewtf.lite.command.macro.invalid_name: '%s' is not a usable name: up to 32 characters, and no pipe character.
wokewtf.lite.command.macro.invalid_text: That line is not usable: it must not be empty and may be at most 256 characters.
wokewtf.lite.command.macro.list.empty: No macros yet. Add one with /wokewtf macro set <name> <text>.
wokewtf.lite.sort_order.name: Name
wokewtf.lite.sort_result.disabled: Inventory Sort is switched off; enable it in the config first.
wokewtf.lite.reason.own_world_only: Only in singleplayer or on the LAN host's own game.
wokewtf.lite.waypoint_result.invalid_nam: '%s' is not a usable name: up to 24 characters, and no '|'.
wokewtf.lite.waypoint_result.duplicate: A waypoint called '%s' already exists in this world.
wokewtf.lite.waypoint_result.not_found: No waypoint called '%s' in this world.
wokewtf.lite.waypoint_result.too_long: Cannot store this one: the entry would be too long.
wokewtf.lite.waypoint_result.no_world: Enter a world before saving a waypoint.
wokewtf.lite.command.waypoint.list.empty: No waypoints in this world yet. Add one with /wokewtf waypoint add <name>.
wokewtf.lite.setting.debugModule.tooltip: A module id such as hud.fps whose activity is logged in detail, or empty for none. The lines go to debug.log. Edited in config/wokewtf-lite.json.
wokewtf.lite.config.title: woke.wtf Lite Settings
wokewtf.lite.config.search.tooltip: Filters the list by module name or description.
wokewtf.lite.config.global.description: Settings that apply to the mod as a whole.
wokewtf.lite.first_join.chat_guide: woke.wtf Lite loaded. Press R-Shift or use /wokewtf config to open settings.
